settings.raw_content_1: Because each wallpaper mural is custom-printed to your specifications, we cannot accept returns once production has begun. However, if your order arrives damaged or with a printing error, we will gladly replace it at no cost. Please inspect your wallpaper upon delivery and contact us within 5 days with photos of any issues so we can make it right.
settings.raw_content_2: All wallpaper murals are made to order and shipped in protective packaging to ensure safe delivery. Standard production time is 5–7 business days, with expedited options available. We ship nationwide in the U.S. Please contact us for international orders.
settings.title_3: What Paper Is Right For You?
settings.raw_content_3:
• Suede Type II 20oz – A heavy-duty commercial-grade wallcovering with a soft matte finish, perfect for high-traffic areas. Best installed by professionals.
  • Terralon Smooth Type II – A sustainable, commercial-grade wallcovering made with over 30% recycled materials. Durable for demanding environments while offering an eco-friendly option. Professional installation recommended.
  • Peel & Stick Linen – A DIY-friendly, removable, and repositionable wallpaper with a subtle fabric texture. No paste or tools required — just peel, stick, and smooth into place. Ideal for renters or temporary installs.
  • Peel & Stick Canvas – A durable self-adhesive wallpaper with a painterly texture that installs easily without paste. Intended as a more permanent solution, best for homeowners wanting a DIY option with a professional look.
  • Pre-Pasted Wallpaper – A lightweight, PVC-free option with water-activated adhesive. Simply soak panels in water, apply to the wall, and smooth out. Perfect for DIY projects, nurseries, and home spaces.

Click HERE for more information.

settings.title: What Types of Wallpaper Materials Do You Offer?
settings.content:
Click HERE to explore our materials.

We offer a wide range of wallpaper materials to suit various needs and preferences, including traditional wallpaper, stick wallpaper, and washable wallpapers. Our selection is curated to ensure durability, ease of installation, and maintenance. Each material is selected for its quality and ability to bring vivid colors and detailed artwork to life on your walls.

settings.title: Can You Create Custom Wallpaper Designs?
settings.content: Yes, we offer fully custom wallpaper design and printing services. You can provide your own artwork, photography, or branding, or work with our team to create a one-of-a-kind wall mural. We also adjust scale, pattern repeat, and material type to ensure your custom wallpaper design perfectly matches your vision.

settings.title: How do you ensure the wallpaper fits my wall perfectly?
settings.content: Every wallpaper order is made to measure. We take your wall dimensions and panel the design into easy-to-install sections for seamless alignment. This custom sizing ensures the wallpaper fits your wall exactly, with professional overlap where needed and minimal waste.

settings.title: Are the wallpapers durable and easy to maintain?
settings.content: Yes. We print on commercial-grade, high-quality wallpaper materials designed for both residential and commercial spaces. Options include washable wallpaper, peel-and-stick wallpaper, and Type II wallcoverings for high-traffic areas. These materials are durable, fade-resistant, and easy to clean, making long-term maintenance simple.

settings.title: Can wallpaper be installed over windows or doors?
settings.content: Wallpaper is not applied directly over windows or doors. Instead, panels are carefully measured, cut, and installed around these areas to maintain functionality while delivering a clean, professional finish. Our installers ensure your wallpaper looks seamless even in complex spaces.
